name: IIBA Operating Model
description: Business architecture of the International Institute of Business Analysis. 6 value streams covering member engagement, certification, knowledge curation, community engagement, partner relations, and thought leadership.

vs_member_engagement_retention_3730be.name: Member Engagement & Retention
vs_member_engagement_retention_3730be.description: Deliver a compelling membership experience that attracts prospective business analysis professionals, onboards them, provides ongoing value and encourages membership renewal. Membership benefits include career development tools, interactive versions of the BABOK/Agile Extension and discounts on certifications. Members can network through chapters and hundreds of events and access knowledge resources .

vs_certification_credential_lifecycle_f1.name: Certification & Credential Lifecycle
vs_certification_credential_lifecycle_f1.description: Provide a globally recognised credentialing pathway that assesses and certifies business analysis competencies. IIBA certifications are promoted as a way to gain career growth, increased earning potential and recognition. Reasons for pursuing certification include industry recognition, career advancement, skill enhancement and networking opportunities

vs_knowledge_standards_curation_2b68a9.name: Knowledge & Standards Curation
vs_knowledge_standards_curation_2b68a9.description: Develop, maintain and disseminate authoritative knowledge and standards that underpin the business analysis profession. IIBA publishes the BABOK Guide, which it calls “the globally recognised standard for the practice of business analysis” , and the Business Analysis Standard, described as the backbone of professional practice that provides a simplified, comprehensive view of business analysis concepts . It also operates the KnowledgeHub, giving members instant online access to the BABOK Guide plus community driven content, such as ‘how do I’ scenarios, videos, tips, tools and templates. Thought leadership white papers and studies are published in collaboration with industry partners to provide guidance and best practices to address digital transformation, agile and new technologies.

vs_community_volunteer_engagement_3857b4.name: Community & Volunteer Engagement
vs_community_volunteer_engagement_3857b4.description: Nurture a vibrant global community of practitioners through local chapters, events, webinars, networking, mentorship and volunteer opportunities. IIBA has “120 chapters in over 40 countries” and chapter membership is described as a “global pass to hundreds of events”. Volunteers play a major role: thousands of IIBA members contribute to the global business analysis community as volunteers and they have opportunities to give back while developing their skills and earning CDUs. Webinars allow members to learn something new, stay informed and connect with the global community, and participants can earn CDUs.

vs_partner_institutional_engagement_5f28.name: Partner & Institutional Engagement
vs_partner_institutional_engagement_5f28.description: Build and maintain relationships with corporate, government, academic and training partners to promote the adoption of business analysis practices within organisations. The Partner Program emphasises resource tailoring, membership and certification packages, networking roundtables and feedback loops: partners can “access resources tailored to your organisation,” “gain more memberships and certifications at every program level,” “join roundtables and events to network with professionals,” and “share your thoughts directly with IIBA’s Product Team”. The program reports that 95 % of partners supporting professional development see improvements, 93 % use feedback to improve processes and 86 % report better quality and more effective BA deliverables. The three tier structure offers flexible certification options, collaborative roundtables, expert led learning events, certification tools and membership management.

vs_thought_leadership_advocacy_f7f5d9.name: Thought Leadership & Advocacy
vs_thought_leadership_advocacy_f7f5d9.description: Advance the business analysis profession by generating and disseminating thought leadership and advocacy. IIBA’s global thought leadership programme publishes white papers and studies in collaboration with industry influencers and partner organisations ; webinars provide expert led insights on leadership, certification preparation and fundamentals. These activities drive awareness of emerging practices and advocate for the value of business analysis within organisations and across industries.

act_member_engagement_retention_market_a.name: Market & Attract Prospects
act_member_engagement_retention_market_a.description: Market IIBA membership and communicate the benefits of joining. Activities include campaigns, social media, webinars and outreach via chapters.

act_member_engagement_retention_register.name: Register & Activate Membership
act_member_engagement_retention_register.description: Guide prospects through membership selection, registration and payment; set up member profiles and grant access to benefits.

act_member_engagement_retention_onboard_.name: Onboard & Orient Member
act_member_engagement_retention_onboard_.description: Educate new members on available benefits (Career Action Guide, BABOK/Agile extension interactive editions, chapter participation, etc.). Provide orientation webinars and connect members with local chapters.

act_member_engagement_retention_deliver_.name: Deliver Ongoing Value
act_member_engagement_retention_deliver_.description: Provide ongoing value through networking (chapters, events), knowledge resources, webinars, white papers and discounts. Encourage participation in volunteer opportunities and communities.

act_member_engagement_retention_renew_or.name: Renew or Exit
act_member_engagement_retention_renew_or.description: Remind members about upcoming expiration, process renewals and handle cancellation/exit feedback. Offer loyalty incentives and gather improvement suggestions.

act_certification_credential_lifecycle_p.name: Promote Certification Options
act_certification_credential_lifecycle_p.description: Promote certification options (ECBA, CCBA, CBAP, AAC, CBDA, CCA, CPOA); Provide information sessions; Help prospects understand prerequisites and select the appropriate level.

act_certification_credential_lifecycle_p.name: Process Application
act_certification_credential_lifecycle_p.description: Facilitate online application submission, documentation upload and payment; review applications and approve or request additional information.

act_certification_credential_lifecycle_p.name: Prepare Candidate
act_certification_credential_lifecycle_p.description: Support candidates in preparing for the exam through endorsed education providers, self study guides, KnowledgeHub materials, white papers and webinars. Members receive discounts on certification resources .

act_certification_credential_lifecycle_d.name: Deliver Examination
act_certification_credential_lifecycle_d.description: Deliver proctored examinations; ensure integrity and fairness; mark exams and communicate results.

act_certification_credential_lifecycle_i.name: Issue Credential
act_certification_credential_lifecycle_i.description: Upon passing, issue certification credential and digital badge; publish to member’s profile; notify candidate’s employer if authorised.

act_certification_credential_lifecycle_m.name: Maintain & Recertify
act_certification_credential_lifecycle_m.description: Manage continuing development requirements and recertification processes. Candidates must earn Continuing Development Units (CDUs) through webinars, chapter events and self directed learning . Send renewal reminders; process recertification applications and audits.

act_knowledge_standards_curation_researc.name: Research & Identify Gaps
act_knowledge_standards_curation_researc.description: Identify emerging trends and knowledge gaps; conduct surveys, salary studies, research and collaborate with SMEs, volunteers and partner organisations to develop new or revised content for standards, knowledge guides, white papers and studies.

act_knowledge_standards_curation_review_.name: Review & Edit Content
act_knowledge_standards_curation_review_.description: Circulate draft content for peer review; apply editorial standards; ensure alignment with the BABOK knowledge areas and Business Analysis Standard; incorporate feedback.

act_knowledge_standards_curation_produce.name: Produce & Distribute
act_knowledge_standards_curation_produce.description: Produce final materials (digital PDF and interactive editions) and distribute via KnowledgeHub, IIBA bookstore or partner channels. For example, the Business Analysis Standard is available as both a digital PDF and an interactive edition in the KnowledgeHub .

act_knowledge_standards_curation_promote.name: Promote & Gather Feedback
act_knowledge_standards_curation_promote.description: Promote published content via webinars, blogs and social media; collect feedback from practitioners, chapters and partners; monitor usage metrics; schedule periodic updates. The KnowledgeHub includes community driven “how do I” content and multimedia elements . White papers and studies address topics like digital transformation and agility .

act_community_volunteer_engagement_recru.name: Recruit & Assign Volunteers
act_community_volunteer_engagement_recru.description: Promote volunteering opportunities; screen applicants; match volunteers to chapter roles or content contribution initiatives; provide orientation and training. Volunteer roles include chapter leadership, event planning and content creation.

act_community_volunteer_engagement_plan_.name: Plan Events & Programmes
act_community_volunteer_engagement_plan_.description: Work with chapters and partners to plan webinars, podcasts, global events, leadership workshops and the Building Business Capability conference. Webinars provide knowledge sharing on topics like leadership development, certification preparation and fundamentals of business analysis. Local chapters host events and study groups.

act_community_volunteer_engagement_facil.name: Facilitate Networking & Mentorship
act_community_volunteer_engagement_facil.description: Connect members with peers through chapter forums, mentorship programmes, discussion boards and online communities. Chapters provide networking and mentorship opportunities ; webinars foster global connections.

act_community_volunteer_engagement_recog.name: Recognise Contributions
act_community_volunteer_engagement_recog.description: Administer volunteer recognition programmes and awards; highlight contributions in newsletters and at events; award continuing development units (CDUs) for volunteer activities.

act_community_volunteer_engagement_colle.name: Collect Feedback & Improve
act_community_volunteer_engagement_colle.description: Collect feedback from event attendees, chapter leaders and volunteers; analyse lessons learned; adjust future events and programmes accordingly.

act_partner_institutional_engagement_pro.name: Prospect & Qualify Partners
act_partner_institutional_engagement_pro.description: Conduct market research and outreach to target corporate, government, academic and training organisations; articulate partner benefits (membership bundles, certification discounts, tailored resources, networking opportunities ).

act_partner_institutional_engagement_neg.name: Negotiate & Onboard
act_partner_institutional_engagement_neg.description: Develop proposals and select appropriate tier of partner programme; agree on contract terms; assign partner managers; onboard partner staff; set up membership and certification allocations.

act_partner_institutional_engagement_del.name: Deliver Partner Value
act_partner_institutional_engagement_del.description: Provide partners with bundled memberships and certification packages; deliver training, exam prep tools and digital resources; invite partner staff to roundtables and expert led learning events; support membership management and reporting .

act_partner_institutional_engagement_eng.name: Engage & Gather Feedback
act_partner_institutional_engagement_eng.description: Conduct partner roundtables, surveys and feedback sessions to understand organisational needs and product improvements. Partners are encouraged to “share your thoughts directly with IIBA’s product team to help guide the program”

act_partner_institutional_engagement_ren.name: Renew or Expand
act_partner_institutional_engagement_ren.description: Discuss renewal or expansion options before contract expiration; propose new packages, additional certifications or advanced training; process renewals

act_thought_leadership_advocacy_monitor_.name: Monitor Trends & Identify Topics
act_thought_leadership_advocacy_monitor_.description: Monitor industry trends (digital transformation, agility, data analytics, cybersecurity) and gather input from practitioners, partners and research to prioritise thought leadership themes.

act_thought_leadership_advocacy_author_d.name: Author & Develop Content
act_thought_leadership_advocacy_author_d.description: Collaborate with subject matter experts, partners and volunteers to author white papers, studies, blog posts, podcasts and webinars. This includes content addressing digital transformation, agile practices and new technologies and webinars on leadership development, certification preparation and fundamentals.

act_thought_leadership_advocacy_publish_.name: Publish & Distribute
act_thought_leadership_advocacy_publish_.description: Publish content through IIBA’s website, KnowledgeHub, blog, podcasts and partner channels; promote through social media, events, newsletters and chapters; highlight IIBA’s advocacy messages.

act_thought_leadership_advocacy_advocate.name: Advocate & Present
act_thought_leadership_advocacy_advocate.description: Present findings to industry forums, government bodies and academia; support adoption of BA standards; participate in conferences; respond to media enquiries; provide commentary to shape policy and practice.
